H Company cofounder Charles Kantor launches new AI neocloud startup

Two Google alumni raise $11.3M to back AI startups that enterprises will actually pay for
a16z-backed EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation to $4B
Oura Hits Pause On IPO While Anthropic’s Prospectus Reveals The Cost Of Its AI Ambitions
Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio, a family of watermarking methods for AI-designed proteins to help with biosecurity and scientific integrity (John Timmer/Ars Technica)
Berlin-based Restate, which provides a durable execution engine to make software workflows resilient to crashes, raised a $20M Series A led by Singular (Marina Temkin/TechCrunch)
Amazon launches a faster Fire TV Stick 4K with a new remote design
Alex Stamos is joining Cognition as its new chief security officer; he most recently oversaw security at AI security startup Corridor and SentinelOne (Sam Sabin/Axios)
ElevenLabs says existing investors and employees have sold $300M worth of stock in a tender led by Wellington and T Rowe Price and valuing the startup at $22B (Tim Bradshaw/Financial Times)
Google reportedly tests paying publishers for AI search results

An interview with OpenAI Chief Research Officer Mark Chen on the Hugging Face incident, slowing AI development, shifting 5%-10% of compute to safety, and more (Will Douglas Heaven/MIT Technology Review)
Restate lands $20M as the need for durable infrastructure increases with AI agents
Amazon aims to have 5,000 drivers wearing its smart glasses in 2026, rising to 20,000+ in 2027; the glasses capture static images for its AI mapping platform (Dave Lee/Bloomberg)
Chinese-powered AI agents show the same deception as their US rivals
Pay-i rebrands as Ascerta and raises $18M to help enterprises track AI business value
‘Losing a piece of my life’: As Amazon’s Mechanical Turk shuts down, gig workers recall the HITs
Climate Week NYC: Amazon’s Kara Hurst on AI data centers; Earthshot’s Jason Knauf on climate optimism
